summary: TH International Ltd filed a Form 6-K with its Q2 2026 earnings release. The filing reports a 21.7% revenue decline, store network changes, and loyalty growth, but no special-situation event. Management discusses strategy and notes the initial tranche of US$15.8 million senior secured convertible notes issued to THRI in July 2026, a routine financing disclosure. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, or other special situation is present. This is a standard earnings current report, hence categorized as None.
